recommendation_2: Apply Bfloat16 Autocast. Wrap the training and inference loops in torch.amp.autocast for CPU execution.
rationale_2: Lowers the precision of computations to 16-bit, drastically reducing the Joules per operation and memory bandwidth pressure on the CPU.
recommendation_3: Apply L1 Unstructured Pruning to the fc layer with amount=0.4. Use torch.nn.utils.prune.l1_unstructured and immediately follow with prune.remove.
rationale_3: Eliminates 40% of redundant weights in the linear layer to reduce the state_dict size transmitted during Flower federated aggregation cycles.
recommendation_4: Execute Layer Scaling on the fc layer. If moving to an MLP based on Hardware Context B, set the first hidden dimension to mid_dim=32 and the second to mid_dim=16.
rationale_4: The current MLP configurations (128 and 64) are oversized for the MNIST input_dim, leading to unnecessary RAM Max spikes and higher power draw.
